**Static class** in the `Latiprimere.Ipp` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Ipp](/docs/reference/#latiprimereipp) package.

```csharp
public static class IppNetworkPrintSystemFactory
```

Creates the IPP network print system, for applications that don't use dependency injection.

## Methods

### Create

```csharp
public static IPrintSystem Create(IppNetworkOptions? options = null)
```

Creates a print system that prints directly to IPP printers on the network.

**Parameters**

- `options`: The configuration, or `null` for discovery only.

**Returns**

The print system. It holds an HTTP connection, so dispose it, for example with `using`, when it is no longer needed.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception): A fingerprint in [IppNetworkOptions.TrustedCertificateFingerprints](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#trustedcertificatefingerprints) or [IppNetworkOptions.PrinterCertificateFingerprints](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#printercertificatefingerprints) isn't 32 bytes in hexadecimal; a credential has no user name, or one containing a colon; a URI in [IppNetworkOptions.PrinterCredentials](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#printercredentials) or [IppNetworkOptions.PrinterCertificateFingerprints](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#printercertificatefingerprints) isn't an absolute ipp or ipps URI; or [IppNetworkOptions.RequireEncryption](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#requireencryption) is set and [IppNetworkOptions.PrinterUris](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#printeruris) has an ipp URI.

```csharp
public static IPrintSystem Create(IPdfRasterizer? pdfRasterizer, IppNetworkOptions? options)
```

Creates a print system that prints directly to IPP printers on the network, and renders PDFs as raster for printers that can't take PDF.

**Parameters**

- `pdfRasterizer`: The rasteriser that renders PDFs for printers that don't take PDF, such as `PdfiumRasterizer` from Latiprimere.Rendering.Pdfium; or `null` to refuse PDFs to such printers.
- `options`: The configuration, or `null` for discovery only.

**Returns**

The print system. It holds an HTTP connection, so dispose it, for example with `using`, when it is no longer needed.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception): A fingerprint in [IppNetworkOptions.TrustedCertificateFingerprints](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#trustedcertificatefingerprints) or [IppNetworkOptions.PrinterCertificateFingerprints](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#printercertificatefingerprints) isn't 32 bytes in hexadecimal; a credential has no user name, or one containing a colon; a URI in [IppNetworkOptions.PrinterCredentials](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#printercredentials) or [IppNetworkOptions.PrinterCertificateFingerprints](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#printercertificatefingerprints) isn't an absolute ipp or ipps URI; or [IppNetworkOptions.RequireEncryption](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#requireencryption) is set and [IppNetworkOptions.PrinterUris](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#printeruris) has an ipp URI.

```csharp
public static IPrintSystem Create(IPdfRasterizer? pdfRasterizer, IppNetworkOptions? options, ILoggerFactory? loggerFactory)
```

Creates a print system that prints directly to IPP printers on the network, renders PDFs as raster for printers that can't take PDF, and logs what it carries on without.

**Parameters**

- `pdfRasterizer`: The rasteriser that renders PDFs for printers that don't take PDF, such as `PdfiumRasterizer` from Latiprimere.Rendering.Pdfium; or `null` to refuse PDFs to such printers.
- `options`: The configuration, or `null` for discovery only.
- `loggerFactory`: The application's logger factory, or `null` to log nothing. The print system logs under the category `Latiprimere.Ipp`.

**Returns**

The print system. It holds an HTTP connection, so dispose it, for example with `using`, when it is no longer needed.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception): A fingerprint in [IppNetworkOptions.TrustedCertificateFingerprints](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#trustedcertificatefingerprints) or [IppNetworkOptions.PrinterCertificateFingerprints](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#printercertificatefingerprints) isn't 32 bytes in hexadecimal; a credential has no user name, or one containing a colon; a URI in [IppNetworkOptions.PrinterCredentials](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#printercredentials) or [IppNetworkOptions.PrinterCertificateFingerprints](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#printercertificatefingerprints) isn't an absolute ipp or ipps URI; or [IppNetworkOptions.RequireEncryption](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#requireencryption) is set and [IppNetworkOptions.PrinterUris](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#printeruris) has an ipp URI.
